errors.evidence: The description incorrectly orders the heating sources for the "Градове" (Cities) category. The correct descending order of shares is: Electricity (38.3%), Wood (22.8%), Central heating (22.7%), Coal (14.9%), and Gas (0.9%). The description incorrectly places "Дърва" (Wood) with 22.8% after "Отопление от централизиран източник" (Central heating) with 22.7% and "Въглища" (Coal) with 14.9%, thus misrepresenting the ranking of the top heating sources.
